main.description: What a private labeler publishes and accepts, with the fields of app.bsky.labeler.service minus its public-only parts.

reasonTypes.description: Report reason codes in scope. If not defined (distinct from empty), all are.

subjectTypes.description: Subject types (account, record, ...) this labeler accepts reports on.

subjectCollections.description: Record collections that can be reported. If not defined (distinct from empty), any.
